table.name: TLGNC_MAT_COMPAT_MAT
table.description: Defines the compatible materials for a material and its threshold values expressed in tlgnc_mat_compat. For one entry in tlgnc_mat_compat, N entries can be listed in this table and are this way defined as compatible within the percentages insignificant_threshold_perc and force_identical_threshold_perc.

column.name: FROM_MAT_COMPAT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_mat_compat. The 'from' material and the percentage interval where only explicitlely defined compatible materials are allowed.

column.name: TO_SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The 'to' material of this material-material compatibility rule, i.e. the material which will be loaded on top.

column.name: MAT_COMPAT_MAT_COMMENT
column.description: A comment which expresses the 'to'-material specific reason for this mat-mat compatibility rule, or since when, or based on what decision, etc.
